claims.text: Al0.5NbTa0.8Ti1.5V0.2Zr is a refractory high-entropy alloy.
Targeted heat treatments can substantially alter the microstructure and ductility of Al0.5NbTa0.8Ti1.5V0.2Zr.
The described processing sequence creates a ductile–brittle–ductile transition.
The conventionally processed alloy has a continuous ordered B2 matrix containing discrete BCC precipitates.
The continuous-B2 initial condition is brittle and has low compressive fracture strain.
Solutionizing at 1400 °C for 20 minutes followed by water quenching produces a weakly ordered, nominally single-phase BCC structure with nanometer-scale B2 regions.
Annealing the solutionized alloy at 600 °C for 120 hours followed by water quenching produces an inverted microstructure.
The inverted microstructure consists of a continuous disordered BCC matrix containing discrete B2 precipitates approximately 50 nm in size.
Mechanical testing is conducted at room temperature in uniaxial compression at an initial strain rate of approximately 0.001 s^-1.
A continuous ordered matrix restricts dislocation mobility and thereby causes brittleness.
A continuous disordered BCC matrix improves dislocation motion and crack blunting.
Discrete B2 precipitates strengthen the alloy without compromising ductility.
The initial continuous-B2 condition has a compressive fracture strain of less than approximately 5%.
Heat treatment can increase compressive ductility to more than approximately 35%.
The inverted, annealed condition specifically has a compressive fracture strain above approximately 35%.
The heat-treated alloy retains moderate yield strength.
The conventionally processed continuous-B2 condition has a yield strength of 2032 MPa and a compressive fracture strain of 4.7%.
The untreated or conventionally processed alloy has high hardness.
The effectiveness of the transition may change under tensile loading, at other temperatures, or after slight composition changes.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis labels the response a ductile–brittle–ductile transition, but the specified sequence starts with a brittle continuous-B2 condition, proceeds to a highly ductile solutionized condition, and then targets another ductile annealed condition. This describes brittle–ductile–ductile rather than ductile–brittle–ductile, and no distinct initial ductile state is identified.
